text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the south side of Adra Grado Way.

The North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space on the south side of Adra Grado Way, between a point 5 metres east of Okra Tomar Crescent (west leg) and a point 5.5 metres further east.
